cliff_driver.text: Mind the doors. Up we go, all 237 metres of it, at a stately pace.
The Cliff Railway opened in 1896 and climbs Constitution Hill. It is the longest electric cliff railway in Britain.
Two cars run on one cable, so one goes up as the other comes down. Very tidy. The gulls ride free and tip nothing.

cliff_walker.text: I came up on the railway and I am walking down. It is the only fair way to treat my knees.
From the top you get a sweep of Cardigan Bay. On a clear day, anyway. On a cloudy day you get my sandwich.
